cues.zh: 用炭火烤硬榫眼（使榫眼更坚固）
cues.en: Fire hardening mortices with coals (strengthens mortices)

cues.zh: 把横梁的榫眼装到柱子上
cues.en: Fitting mortices of beams on to posts
Making a kiln grate from clay
Making holes to let the flames through
Digging a trench for the kiln firebox
Stone lintel for the firebox entry

cues.zh: 搅拌窑壁用泥（只用挖出的土和水）
cues.en: Mixing mud for kiln walls (just excavated dirt and water)

cues.zh: 从小屋旁的溪岸挖黏土
cues.en: Digging clay from the creek bank next to hut

cues.zh: 碾碎旧陶器加入新黏土（使其更坚固）
cues.en: Crushing up old pottery to add to new clay (strengthens it)

cues.zh: 在石头上撒木灰（防止黏土粘连）
cues.en: Sprinkle wood ash on stone (prevents clay sticking)

cues.zh: 瓦片存放在木棚里避雨
cues.en: Tiles stored in wood shed out of rain

cues.zh: 瓦片烧到红热时就 ready 了
cues.en: When the tiles glow red hot they're ready

cues.zh: 铺设瓦片（瓦片靠搭扣搭放，无需木钉）
cues.en: Putting tiles in place (they just sit on using their tabs, no pegs necessary)

cues.zh: 给火箱加炉条（使热量产出提高数倍）
cues.en: Adding grate bars to the firebox (increases heat production several times)

cues.zh: 制作弧形盖瓦（普通瓦片不带凸耳，折叠在木棍上）
cues.en: Making curved cap tiles (normal tiles without tabs folded over a log)
A tile goes on one side

cues.zh: 然后从另一侧再放一块，盖住刚放好的瓦片
cues.en: Then another from the other side covers the tile just put in place

cues.zh: 最后，盖瓦封住瓦片之间的垂直缝隙
cues.en: Finally, the cap tile covers the vertical gap between tiles

cues.zh: 墙体石砌基座（防止潮气上升）
cues.en: Stone footing for wall (prevents rising damp)

cues.zh: 前方的火在石块下流动
cues.en: Fire at the front moves under stones

cues.zh: 后方加烟囱以增强抽风
cues.en: Chimney added at back to enhance draft

cues.zh: 加热的平台很暖和，是睡觉的好地方
cues.en: Heated platform is warm and makes a good bed

cues.zh: 墙中加入石块以节省泥料
cues.en: Stones added to wall to save on mud
Chimney protected from rain by tiles

cues.zh: 木制过梁构成门口顶部
cues.en: Wooden lintel forms top of door way
Resin on tile as a lamp
